name: open-world-clock-cloudflare
description: Cloudflare Pages config for openworldclock.com: the static site in ../site plus the /ingest PostHog proxy Function.

scripts.predeploy: node seo-check.mjs && node csp-hashes.mjs && node asset-versions.mjs && node ../scripts/build-web.mjs --check && node site-chrome.mjs && node check-links.mjs
